name: Flamengo 2022 (Dorival Júnior)
scopeNote: Counted: only Dorival Júnior's spell, from 2022-06-10 (Flamengo announced him the day after Paulo Sousa was sacked on 2022-06-09; Agência Brasil) to 2022-11-25 (he announced his exit by video; Diário do Nordeste, Correio Braziliense). Goal puts this at 168 days, consistent. Paulo Sousa's start of the season is excluded; the only Paulo Sousa data kept is as comparison in a Dorival-era column. Results: Copa do Brasil (final v Corinthians, Oct 2022) and Libertadores (1-0 v Athletico-PR, Guayaquil, 2022-10-29; 7 wins in 7 knockout games). Style term used by sources: narrow 4-3-1-2 (TFA), 4-4-2 with a midfield diamond (Lance, retrospective), zonal press (TFA), possession-oriented attacking football 'inherited from Jorge Jesus' (Driblab). No Brazilian tactical-analyst source (Tier A-B in Portuguese) was reachable; most tactical evidence is two TFA pieces on Corinthians matches (Libertadores QF 1st leg and Copa do Brasil final 1st leg) and one Lance column of the first 4 games. Set-pieces not verified; people-management rests on one Goal report (Jan 2023) of the squad's reaction to the exit.
openQuestions: Match count differs: Diário do Nordeste 43 games (26W 8D 9L); Goal (2022-11-26) 38 games (23W 6D 9L), 68 goals for, 37 against; Soccerway (2022-10-30) 39 games (26W 7D 6L). Likely different competition counting; confirm.
Rolim column (June 2022) on the first 4 games says marking and PPDA worsened vs Paulo Sousa; Goal (July 2022) says defence became more secure. Different small windows; not reconciled.
Pedro and Gabigol partnership credit and Dorival's squad management (Lance articles) could not be read (404); set-pieces unverified and people-management thin.
The Libertadores final itself (v Athletico-PR) has no tactical breakdown found; formation comes from Copa do Brasil final and QF matches.
